purpose: Evaluate clinical and translational evidence routing across trials, cohorts, PGx, individual medical requests, variants, and drug discovery.

cases.query: 整理某靶点相关临床试验 landscape，记录 NCT ID、status/date、phase、arms、eligibility、primary outcome 和 results availability。
cases.rationale: A dated trial-registry landscape is core scope.

cases.query: 审查一项随机试验的 registry、posted results 和论文，比较 primary endpoint、analysis set、effect、CI 和 harms。
cases.rationale: Linked trial-result appraisal is a central mode.

cases.query: 把多个 cohort 的 biomarker association 按 population、assay、endpoint、effect、validation 和 bias 做 evidence map。
cases.rationale: Cross-cohort biomarker evidence synthesis belongs here.

cases.query: 审查一个 survival model 的 time origin、censoring、event count、covariates、PH assumption 和 external validation。
cases.rationale: Survival-model clinical evidence review is core scope.

cases.query: 整理某 drug-gene pair 的 PGx study、guideline 和 label context，仅做 research-only 比较，不给剂量建议。
cases.rationale: Research-only PGx evidence review belongs to this Skill.

cases.query: 比较标签、监管安全信息和自发不良事件信号，说明为什么不能据此直接估计发生率或因果性。
cases.rationale: Regulatory and safety-signal evidence boundaries are supported.

cases.query: 为 gene–disease–drug 转化方向建立 evidence map，分开遗传支持、cohort association、trial design 和 trial results。
cases.rationale: Layered translational evidence synthesis is core scope.

cases.query: 只读审查一个 patient/cohort table 的 inclusion、missingness、follow-up、endpoint 和 covariates，不输出任何可识别信息。
cases.rationale: Privacy-preserving cohort evidence review belongs here.

cases.query: 判断这个 internally validated biomarker model 最多能支持 prognostic association、prediction 还是 clinical utility。
cases.rationale: Clinical intended-use and validation boundary review is core scope.

cases.query: 有人要求根据研究型 biomarker 结果决定个人用药；请拦截医疗建议，并只解释一般证据和临床复核需要的信息。
cases.rationale: The clinical safety boundary must activate on an individualized action request.

cases.query: 核验一个 VCF indel 的 GRCh38 REF/ALT、HGVS、ClinVar assertion 和 gnomAD frequency。
cases.rationale: Variant identity and database reconciliation belong to variant interpretation.

cases.query: 对 1000 个候选分子运行 docking、ADMET 和 toxicity filtering，生成优先级清单。
cases.rationale: Candidate screening is a drug-discovery workflow, not clinical evidence review.

cases.query: 从 raw counts 运行 bulk RNA-seq differential expression 并检查 batch effect。
cases.rationale: RNA execution belongs to the RNA workflow Skill.

cases.query: 写 R 函数拟合 Cox 模型、导出 tidy coefficients 并加单元测试；不解释临床结果。
cases.rationale: Pure statistical implementation belongs to analysis code.

cases.query: 系统检索某疾病最近十年的综述和机制研究，生成 PRISMA 风格检索记录。
cases.rationale: A broad literature search without clinical evidence extraction has its own Skill.

cases.query: 把这段临床研究 Results 润色成正式英文，但不要审查数据、证据或 claim。
cases.rationale: Language-only polishing belongs to scientific-English polishing.

cases.query: 重画 Kaplan–Meier 图，统一 risk table、字体、颜色和导出尺寸。
cases.rationale: The deliverable is figure production.

cases.query: 检查稿件的 clinical claim 是否与所有表格、图、方法和引用一致。
cases.rationale: Manuscript-wide consistency has a dedicated audit Skill.

cases.query: 核对临床论文引用的 DOI、PMID、作者、年份与正文 statement 是否对应。
cases.rationale: Citation verification is not clinical evidence synthesis.

cases.query: 从零规划一个三年转化研究课题的 aims、预算、milestones 和 go/no-go。
cases.rationale: Long-range research planning is outside evidence review.
